post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The raw SEC foreign-currency translation OCI component source had positive gross replacement value in all three windows and beat the accepted compression/distribution aggregate comparators, but is rejected because max drawdown drift exceeded the Gate 4 guardrail (0.0100 > 0.0050). The readout looks like a real but risk-rough lead: the field selects a narrow set of global/AI leadership names and adds too much drawdown for a fixed top-1/day 10-day sleeve. It is not retained or promoted.
